Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can get a technical deep dive scheduled: 

Recap (topline)
- Primary use case: in-product summarization + contextual search for customer support transcripts (high QPS, low latency requirement on hot paths)
- Data classification: PII in transcripts, need strong controls (SSO, field-level redaction option, KMS integration)
- Deployment preference: hosted to start, likely Dedicated/Private later for compliance
- Success metrics: <200ms median token latency, predictable costs per 1M tokens

Next steps
- Technical deep dive + demo (30-45m) to review integration patterns, perf expectations, and security controls
- Looping in security and our SE to cover SOC2, SSO, and data flow

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 7/15, 11:00-11:45am PT
- Thu 7/16, 9:00-9:45am PT

Can you confirm which works or share a preferred time? Also please confirm who from FinPath should join — I assume your Security lead and someone from Procurement might want to join. I attached a short demo agenda to this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
